Subject: Demo request — evaluating Redwood for conversational search at Mallory

Hi Priyom,

Thanks — I signed up via the self-serve flow and poked around the hosted API. We're evaluating Redwood to replace a homegrown inference layer powering our site search and a chat-based product assistant. A few quick details to help you triage before we book a slot: 

- Use case: blended search + chat (user asks + system synthesizes product feed + personalization signals).
- Typical query length: 20-60 tokens; synth responses average 80–150 tokens.
- Traffic: currently ~500 QPS at peak across our retail sites; for the pilot we'd route ~5–10 QPS initially.
- Concurrency target for pilot: 20 concurrent sessions.
- Timeline: pilot in 6–8 weeks, production rollout in Q4 if perf/cost look good.

Happy to hop on a 30-min demo — I can do Monday or Tuesday mornings PT next week. Can you send a few slots and any prep checklist you want us to fill out?

Thanks,
Jordan Simmons
Head of Search + Personalization
Brightly / Mallory Retail

Jordan — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the concise summary. A few quick qualification items so the demo focuses on what matters: 

1) Production constraints: when you say 500 QPS at peak, is that sustained over minutes/hours or short spikes around site events? Rough distribution helps us talk about batching + autoscaling.
2) Latency SLO: are you targeting p95 < 200ms for user-facing chat? Or is slightly higher acceptable for richer answers?
3) Data controls: will any PII or payment-related info be in prompts? If so we can review Private deployment options.
4) Sandbox assets: could you attach a small sample of the user queries + expected output (anonymized) and an example product feed snippet? That will help us bring the right kernels and quantization notes to the call.
